title: UK and St George’s flags should never be used to ‘intimidate and terrify’, says senior Lib Dem
summary: ‘How dare the nationalists steal our flags?’ asks Tim Farron at party conference in Bournemouth People who use the union jack or St George’s cross as a form of aggressive nationalism do not love their country, a senior Liberal Democrat has said, as he hit back at a wave of hard-right activism based around the flags. In a strongly worded speech to a rally opening the party’s annual conference in Bournemouth, Tim Farron, a former leader who now speaks for the party on the environment and rural affairs, said national flags should never be “used to intimidate”. title: Man armed with gun and knife detained at Charlie Kirk memorial service venue
summary: US Secret Service in Phoenix says man said he was law enforcement and there to provide private security A man armed with a gun and a knife was detained Saturday at State Farm Stadium near Phoenix before Charlie Kirk ’s memorial service at that venue on Sunday – with authorities accusing him of brandishing inactive law enforcement credentials and lacking permission to be there. In a statement released Saturday, the US Secret Service said that it was coordinating with local law enforcement in Glendale, Arizona, to investigate “an individual who was observed exhibiting suspicious behavior at State Farm Stadium”.
